liens.raison: Some locations have higher rates of fraud
Certain payment methods might be more prone to fraud
Online purchases, POS payments, bill payments, bank transfers, and ATM withdrawals can potentially involve fraud
Certain devices might be more susceptible to fraud
Different locations might prefer different transaction types
Different devices might be preferred in certain locations
Peak hours or specific times may have higher rates of fraud
More transactions in 24 hours may increase the likelihood of fraud
Older accounts may have more transactions

commentaire_expert: This DAG represents a causal relationship between the given variables. Older accounts, certain locations, transaction types, devices, payment methods, time of transaction, transaction amount, number of transactions in the last 24 hours, and previous fraudulent transactions may all influence the likelihood of fraud. Note that this is just one possible interpretation of the data and further analysis might lead to different conclusions.
